lines.text: When was the last time you actually changed your smartphone passcode?
Most people use the exact same four or six-digit PIN for years without thinking twice.
Over months of daily swiping, your finger oils leave subtle smudge trails on the glass.
Under angled light or thermal cameras, anyone standing behind you can easily reconstruct your code.
Even worse, automated brute-force cracking tools test common combinations in seconds.
Once someone has your device PIN, they can reset your Apple ID, passwords, and banking apps.
Change your passcode to a strong six-digit mix today to keep your digital life safe.
